provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code over Z_465: H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T] with a = 1 + x + x^19 and b = 1 + x^141 + x^238; gcd(a, b, x^465 - 1) has degree 9 (irreducible factors of degrees 4 and 5), so k = 18 by design. Every check has weight 6.
